title: pharmsol: A high-performance Rust library for pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic modeling and simulation
description: pharmsol is a high-performance Rust library for pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) modeling and simulation. It provides tools for defining, solving, and analyzing compartmental models, with support for differential equations, their analytical solutions, and experimental support for stochastic differential equations.
